defaults.style: Style: a flat, high-contrast product illustration of a wide Eurorack module front panel, drawn in the visual language of the attached reference: warm light-grey panel #E4E2DD, bold uniform black outlines about 2 px, related controls grouped inside white rounded rectangles with black outlines, large matte black knobs with one thin white pointer line, small black pill-shaped sublabels, thick black label bars, no gradients across the panel, no ornaments, only a soft contact shadow under knobs, buttons and jacks. Palette: light grey #E4E2DD, white #F6F4EF, black #111111, mid grey #8A8A86, exactly one accent colour warm amber #F2A81D used only for lit buttons and tiny LEDs.

inputs.role: style reference only: copy its line weight, rounded outlined groups, black pill sublabels, big black knobs and black boxes. Do NOT copy its layout, control count, text, logos or colours.

jobs.subject: Subject: the complete front panel of a wide Eurorack module, 42 HP wide (213 mm) and 128.5 mm tall, seen perfectly straight on, landscape orientation, the panel filling the whole image with no rack, no wall and no hands around it. Left: one tall white rounded-rectangle group with black outline holding a neat grid of four columns and eight rows of black round jacks with silver rings and tiny amber LED dots, separated by thin black lines. Centre: a white rounded group with two large matte black knobs with white pointers at the top, a small black rounded display with thin amber text-like marks and no readable letters, four smaller black knobs, and two rows of small flat white round buttons with black rings, two of them lit amber. Right: five white rounded-rectangle groups, each with a small black pill header tab sitting on its top outline (blank, no letters), each holding a neat grid of flat white round buttons with black rings, most unlit and a few lit amber, plus a few black knobs. A thick black blank title bar along the bottom centre. Strict grid alignment, all labels are blank short black bars and pills, no letters visible.
